{{Quote|It's not easy &hellip; sort of like talking under water.|Halla describes the language of the Coway to Luke Skywalker and Leia Organa|<ref name="Splinter of the Mind's Eye">''[[Splinter of the Mind's Eye]]''</ref>}}
'''Coway''' was the language spoken by the [[Coway]], a subterranean [[Species/Legends|species]] native to [[Mimban/Legends|Mimban]]. Though the culture of the Coway was considerably different from that of their fellow planet-dwellers and genetic cousins, the [[Mimbanite]]s, the language of the Coway was similar to the [[Mimbanite (language)|Mimbanite language]]. [[Halla]] knew some of the Coway tongue, and used it to allow [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] a chance to save her, [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]], [[Hin]], [[Kee (Yuzzem)|Kee]], and the [[Droid/Legends|droids]] [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] and [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]], after their capture by the Coway.

==Vocabulary==
'''''saen''''': A local Coway swear word which may have something to do with insulting one's parentage.
